scientific_question: Can the SOSE Manufacturing PC5 canonical preserve preregistered durable invariants and recover the mechanistic effects of implemented finite disruption scenarios under deterministic replicated A0 execution?

claims.falsification: any invariant violation falsifies the claim

claims.target: yield-degradation reduces durable output/yield relative to paired nominal execution when completion is eligible
claims.eligibility: paired nominal/yield worlds with completed orders
claims.falsification: paired yield arm does not reduce output/yield as configured

claims.target: machine downtime produces durable breakdown/machine_down evidence and does not bypass resource reacquisition
claims.eligibility: worlds in which downtime overlaps an eligible setup/production interval
claims.falsification: downtime fails to produce required durable breakdown/recovery evidence

non_claims: no demand-surge effect claim unless preflight proves executable durable workload impact before freeze

quantity.bounds: TBD by preflight against executable Manufacturing capacities

replication.crn: paired arms share framework-assigned comparison groups

eligibility_rules: terminal lead_time/yield claims require completed orders
stationary analytical comparisons are ineligible because none are preregistered
scenario claims require executable overlap/activation semantics established by preflight
exclusions: worlds are not excluded post hoc for poor performance or tail behavior
implementation/protocol defects require versioned deviation and complete rerun
freeze_rule: No official result execution or inspection before status becomes frozen and all TBD fields are resolved.
